title: ze_obscura_tower
description:
Ze_Obscura_Tower 

 Map by Kuroki and Chemodan 

In ancient medieval times, there was a great city, protected by strong walls and a mighty castle. But one day, darkness awakened ancient forces that had long been asleep. A strange plague spread among the people, turning them into soulless creatures hungry for flesh. Many cities fell, the streets became overrun with the undead, and the few survivors lived in constant fear.

Realizing the danger, the King commanded his army to reclaim the castle, now consumed by evil. Brave warriors and desperate survivors united to face the ancient being lurking within the fortress, hoping to destroy it and end the nightmare once and for all.

The map takes players through multiple levels filled with fantasy elements: the dark streets of the infected city, hidden dungeons, ruined villages, and finally the castle itself—the heart of the corruption. Only by overcoming every trial and defeating the ancient evil can the world be saved from total collapse.

==This map is made for Source2ZE Mapping Contest «Return to Roots»==
